description: Set the PFC cycling status. If off, PFC receives the coupling information from CFD, computes a new drag force and porosity, and returns control to CFD without cycling forward in time. By default, cycling is on.

examples.description: Let PFC cycle forward during coupling

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): accepted with on and off on all three consoles.
